unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #6 (live, verified open): "Add a Nano (XNO) settlement option beside the Kite rail in the wrapper templates and manifest schema". Names the exact files a Nano leg would go in: schema/service.schema.json (extend network enum with nano:mainnet, widen pay_to to nano_...), templates/typescript-express/src/kite.ts (add NanoChain + nanoMoneyParser, x402 SDK already supports nano:mainnet), templates/go-gin, CONTRIBUTING.md. Framed as an additional rail, never a replacement; verify->upstream->settle ordering unchanged. Open-research disclosure implied by public issue.
